name: grpc
title: OpenTelemetry OTLP (gRPC)
summary: An OpenTelemetry collector's OTLP/gRPC trace receiver (TraceService/Export) from the upstream Apache-2.0 protos, with partial-success, unavailable and deadline scenarios for testing exporters.

upstream.notes: The embedded contract is the upstream trace_service.proto, trace.proto, resource.proto and common.proto at this commit, merged into one file (one package, same field numbers and service path) because a config contract is a single .proto. The upstream set spans several files with imports, so there is no single file for `init --full` to fetch.
